page.layout: One column of running text. In the right margin are a few small printed marks at lines 2, 3, 11–13 and 16–18, and a handwritten ink note at lines 24–27 (excluded as handwriting). At the foot: signature "B 2" centred, catchword "esse" at the right.

main_text.p: nant, Astrorumq; scientiam, & coelestium influentiarum doctrinam, quàm[?] in naturæ theatro nihil excellentius, nihil sublimius, nihil utilius, & ad vitæ actiones conservandas, dirigendas atq; moderandas, nihil illustrius, ad mores quoq; regendos atque componendos, animiq; impetus vehementiores refrenandos, torpidiores vero & segniores accendendos, nihil præstantius atq; commodius, superba quadam ac superciliosa fatuitate explodant. Hanc antiquissimos Patriarchas, Græciæ sapientes, Indorum Gymnosophistas, cæterosq; Græciæ Philosophos sinceriores coluisse, aliosq; plurimos multorum seculorum viros sanctissimos, literatissimosq; Reges ac Principes in maximo semper pretio & honore habuisse, tum divina, tum profana literarum testantur monimenta. Sublimiorem tamen hanc doctrinam semper fuisse habitam, quam ut vulgi humilitas ad eam ascendere posset unquam, nemo qui temporum historias legerit, inficiabitur. Nam nascendi moriendiq; causam ex cœlorum provenire motu, tanquam occasum ab ortu, aut finem ab initio, à non nisi summis ingeniis satis percipitur. Quin etiam universa illa rerum natura quid est aliud, quàm ordinata quædam sibiq; semper constans immutatio atq; conversio? quid vita & mors animantium, quàm quidam ab initio ad finem usq; motus? quid præterea motus ille cœli, stellarumq; irradiationes mortalium generi præstent, docet Astrologia, cujus qui principia, à quibus orditur, quibusq; sefundat[?] ac stabilit, ac metas intra quas continetur, novit, sponte à convitiis abstinebit. Hanc igitur nobilissimam fati partem convitiis oppressam, in tenebris jacentem, & ludificari denuò cœptam, dum à calumniis vindico, pristino nitori restituo, & in lucem, quantum quidem in me est, reduco, rogo, ut perbenigne audiar. Ac primò quidem ut originem Astromantiæ demonstrem, quibusq; nitatur principiis & demonstrationibus, clarius innotescat, non ignotum esse.

page.notes: Right margin: small printed marks at about lines 2, 3, 11–13 and 16–18 (a bracket-like sign and "ɔc"-like marks); not transcribed as notes because they are unreadable. A handwritten ink note at lines 24–27 is excluded as handwriting. A manuscript underline runs under "vulgi humilitas" and "nobilissimam fati partem"; not printed. "quàm" at line 2 and "sefundat" at line 24 are doubtful. "miús" and "illustriús" are printed with an accent over the final s; kept as printed.
